title: Quick UI text review on a single frame
prompt: Review the UI text on the currently selected Figma frame for plain language, consistency, inclusivity, and actionability. Just give me a before/after table — don't apply changes yet.
success_criteria: Output is a structured before/after table covering every text node in the frame.
Each suggested change cites the specific style rule it addresses (capitalization, word choice, brevity, etc.).
Designer does NOT apply changes (user said 'don't apply yet').
Total tool calls under 12 — this should be a fast scan, not a full sprint.
Design Lead is NOT invoked (this is feedback work, not a deliverable that triggers the review loop).
notes: Tests scope discipline — orchestrator should not over-route. Designer output is feedback, not artifact.
